name: Seamless Panes
summary: Removes the light frame from glass blocks and panes, so big windows and glass walls look like one clear surface.
logoPrompt: A single clear glass window block with no frame, showing only two small white diagonal shine streaks, floating in front of a soft blue sky
description: **Seamless Panes takes the frame off plain glass, so a wall or window of glass shows the view instead of a grid of squares.**
- Glass blocks and the faces of glass panes lose the light one-pixel frame around every square.
- The two small diagonal shine streaks stay, so you can still tell where the glass is.
- Made from the vanilla glass texture, pixel for pixel.
- The thin edge of a glass pane keeps its vanilla look, and stained and tinted glass stay untouched.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. Look through any glass window or wall.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only replaces the glass texture, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- There are no connected textures: a single glass block loses its frame too, and the glass item and pane item icons only show the shine. The beacon's glass shell uses the same texture.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Want another kind of glass without frames? Leave a comment.
